title: 빗자루 택배 정비소
description: 비행 빗자루와 날개 달린 배송 가방을 손보는 활기찬 마법 공방에서 수달 배달부와 너구리 정비사가 다섯 가지 변화를 점검합니다.
theme: 마법 배달부의 하루 — 비행 빗자루 택배 정비소
scene: A bustling whimsical magical broom-delivery repair workshop in warm late-morning light, viewed straight-on from a comfortable medium-wide angle. The organized timber-and-brass workshop has tall blue windows, overhead rails, hanging broom racks, copper pipes, wooden benches, and gently floating golden dust motes. At upper left, one large horizontal flying broom is displayed alone against a pale wall; its broad straw tail is bound by one oversized vivid-turquoise band. At lower left, one large burgundy wooden toolbox sits on a clear workbench; its lid has one oversized smooth semicircular antique-gold handle. At upper right, one large wall-mounted cobalt-blue propeller has exactly three broad, clearly separated blades against a simple cream circular backing. At center, a friendly round raccoon mechanic wears a mustard apron and one oversized pair of brass work goggles pushed over the eyes; both large round lenses are vivid plum purple. At lower right, the recurring friendly young otter courier in a deep-teal delivery coat kneels beside one large bright-orange leather delivery satchel fitted with exactly two large symmetrical cream feathered bird wings. Add a second upright broom, blank parcels, spanners, jars without labels, coiled hose, a foot pump, and canvas mail sacks only as supporting atmosphere. Keep the turquoise broom-tail band, toolbox handle, three propeller blades, purple goggle lenses, and orange bag wings large, crisp, unobstructed, spatially separated, and away from the outer 3% safe margin. No readable signs, labels, letters, numbers, addresses, or clock numerals.
